name: Mary (wife of Clopas)
title: Faithful Witness at the Cross
summary: Mary, wife of Clopas, was one of the faithful women who followed Jesus and were present at his crucifixion. She witnessed Jesus' death and empty tomb, and is mentioned among the women standing by the cross along with Mary the mother of Jesus and Mary Magdalene.

keyEvents.title: At Jesus' Cross
keyEvents.description: Mary stood faithfully by Jesus' cross with other women, witnessing his suffering and death at Golgotha.

keyEvents.title: Witness to the Crucifixion
keyEvents.description: She was among the women who had followed Jesus from Galilee and served him, and who now watched from a distance during the crucifixion.

keyEvents.title: At the Tomb
keyEvents.description: Mary was likely among the women who saw where Jesus was laid and later came to the tomb with fragrant spices.
